record_title: Rank-one shear obstructions to CPPm on diagonal ℓp-sums
provenance: Scientific sources and verification evidence are listed in RESULT.md and REVIEW.md.
limitations: The theorem applies to an explicit isometric decomposition X=Z⊕_pY with Y non-reflexive; it does not characterize CPPm on arbitrary non-reflexive spaces or under equivalent renormings. Originality is to the best of our knowledge; the construction extends recent CPPm shear arguments using classical ingredients.
